title: unified-rollouts-canonical-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Arjun Patel
description: Context: Consolidate multiple ad-hoc canary/AB/shadow rollout workflows into a single canonical autorollback workflow that supports metric-driven rollbacks, quorum-based quarantine, staged probing, and transparent observability hooks. Motivation: teams currently replicate similar logic across services which increases maintenance cost and causes inconsistent safety behavior during incidents; this PR provides a single orchestrator and a stable contract for rollout policies. Changes include: new workflow engine (rollout/engine), rollout API extensions (api/v1/rollouts.proto), observability metrics and dashboards (observability/rollback_metrics), e2e test harness for canary+shadow scenarios (e2e/tests/canary_shadow_rollback.test), SDK helpers and examples. Checklist: - [x] Design doc accepted (Linear ENG-2345) - [x] Unit tests added/updated - [x] Integration tests for policy evaluation - [x] E2E canary+shadow failure simulation - [x] Telemetry and per-stage metrics instrumented - [x] Backwards-compatible with existing rollout CRs Migration notes: new workflow is backwards-compatible by default; clusters continue to use legacy engine until 'workflowVersion: v2' is set. For Dedicated customers we added an opt-in flag and a migration helper script. See docs/unified-rollouts.md for usage examples and rollout policy grammar. Testing instructions: run `./dev/rollout/test_canary_shadow.sh` for the e2e suite; use the local dev harness to simulate metric regressions and verify autorollback triggers. Related: ENG-2367 addresses observability gaps; SUP-4021 was the support case that motivated quarantine behavior refinements.

release_notes: Add canonical autorollback workflow that unifies canary, A/B, and shadow traffic rollouts.
Expose `rollbackSLO` in rollout policy for metric-driven automated rollback thresholds.
Add staged probing and quarantine policy to reduce noisy rollouts and support manual quarantine/unquarantine flows.
New telemetry: per-rollout and per-stage metrics to improve rollback observability.
E2E tests added to cover canary+shadow autorollback scenarios.
notes: This PR consolidates years of ad-hoc rollout logic; please coordinate with Platform and SRE for production rollout. Customers on Dedicated clusters should coordinate a maintenance window for migration if they opt in to `workflowVersion: v2`.
backout_procedure: Documented in docs/unified-rollouts.md under 'rollback and backout'. Includes immediate disable option, canary weight revert, and manual rollback CLI commands.
qa_followup: Monitor per-rollout metrics for first 72 hours after staged rollout; set temporary alerts for error-rate delta > 0.5% and latency P95 increase > 25%.
